mentions.name: GigClub
mentions.description: A Letterboxd-style platform for live events, focused on the UK. It is currently in a waitlist phase, with a long-term plan to build an enthusiastic community around live events and eventually become a primary ticket seller.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://GigClub.live

Letterboxd for live events. Currently a waitlist system in place, and we're very UK-focussed.

The long-term plan is to build a really enthusiastic community and then become a primary ticket seller.
